zh.title: 勞斯萊斯UltraFan 80第二具示範引擎預計近期運轉
zh.summary: 勞斯萊斯開發新一代客機引擎；UltraFan 80第二具示範引擎預計近期運轉
body: Simple Flying報導，第二具UltraFan 80示範引擎預計近期運轉。這項說法表達的是未來預期，而非已完成的運轉。報導也指出，勞斯萊斯正開發新一代寬體與窄體客機引擎。
報導將示範引擎預計運轉一事，置於勞斯萊斯新一代引擎的開發脈絡中；但目前所述僅為預計近期運轉，不能據此說該次運轉已經發生。相關引擎開發涵蓋寬體與窄體客機，報導未提供更明確的運轉日期。

en.title: Second UltraFan 80 Demonstrator Expected to Run Soon as Rolls-Royce Develops New Engines
en.summary: Rolls-Royce develops new airliner engines; second UltraFan 80 demonstrator is expected to run soon.
body: Simple Flying reports that the second UltraFan 80 demonstrator is expected to run soon. The wording describes a future expectation, not a completed run. The report also says Rolls-Royce is developing a new generation of engines for widebody and narrowbody airliners.

The expected demonstrator run is presented in the context of that engine-development effort. The information describes the run as forthcoming, but does not establish that it has already taken place. The timing given is “soon,” with no more precise date stated.

zh.title: 漢莎航空預定執行空中巴士A340-600最後客運航班
zh.summary: 漢莎航空預定執行A340-600最後客運服務，安排仍可能變動
body: 漢莎航空預定於10月18日執行空中巴士A340-600最後一班客運服務。這趟航班預定標誌漢莎航空A340-600定期客運營運的結束，但安排仍可能因營運狀況變動而調整。
航班LH419預定於當地時間下午5時55分自華盛頓杜勒斯（IAD）起飛，並於10月19日上午7時55分抵達法蘭克福機場（FRA）。報導指出，執行最後一班客運服務的飛機尚未獲得獨立確認；漢莎航空仍保留四架A340-600供剩餘營運使用。

en.title: Lufthansa schedules final Airbus A340-600 passenger service for October 18
en.summary: Lufthansa schedules its final A340-600 passenger service, subject to operational changes.
body: Lufthansa is scheduled to operate its final Airbus A340-600 passenger service on October 18. The flight marks the planned end of Lufthansa’s scheduled A340-600 passenger operations, subject to operational changes.

Flight LH419 is due to depart Washington Dulles (IAD) at 5.55 pm local time and arrive at Frankfurt Airport (FRA) at 7.55 am on October 19. The aircraft assigned to the final passenger service has not been independently confirmed at the time of writing. Lufthansa has retained four A340-600s for its remaining operations.

zh.title: LATAM波音767空中緊急下降2萬3千英尺 氧氣面罩落下
zh.summary: LATAM波音767宣告7700緊急代碼並下降2萬3千英尺，氧氣面罩落下，隨後返回利馬
body: 根據Simple Flying報導，LATAM一架波音767在飛行途中發生空中緊急狀況，機組宣告7700緊急代碼。
報導指出，該機執行了立即下降，下降高度達2萬3千英尺，過程中氧氣面罩落下。
Simple Flying的摘要指出，機組隨後將該架767返回利馬。
報導以「空中緊急狀況」描述此事件，並提到7700緊急代碼與氧氣面罩落下。
目前可取得的公開資訊僅限Simple Flying的報導摘要，未說明事件發生的具體日期、飛行階段、可能原因或人員傷亡情況。

en.title: LATAM Boeing 767 descends 23,000 feet with oxygen masks deployed in midair emergency
en.summary: LATAM Boeing 767 declared a 7700 emergency, descended 23,000 feet with oxygen masks deployed, then returned to Lima
body: A LATAM Boeing 767 was involved in a midair emergency, according to Simple Flying. The crew declared a transponder 7700 emergency.
The report states the crew executed an immediate descent of 23,000 feet, and that oxygen masks deployed during the event.
Simple Flying's summary states the jet was then returned to Lima.
The available account describes the event as a midair emergency and cites the 7700 declaration and the deployment of oxygen masks.
The available public information is limited to the Simple Flying report summary. It does not state the date of the event, the phase of flight, a possible cause, or any casualties or injuries.
